source.author: verg
source.text: Excudent alii spirantia mollius aera, credo equidem, vivos ducent de marmore voltus, orabunt causas melius, caelique meatus describent radio, et surgentia sidera dicent:
source.text_original: Excudent alii spirantia mollius aera, / credo equidem, vivos ducent de marmore voltus, / orabunt causas melius, caelique meatus / describent radio, et surgentia sidera dicent: /
source.text_english: Others will hammer out more smoothly breathing bronzes, I for one believe it; they will draw living faces from marble, plead cases better, and with the compass describe the courses of the sky, and tell of the rising stars:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Legimus in scolis pueri et spirantia in plateis aera conspeximus aliquem ossibus uix haerentem illicitis arsisse amoribus et ante uita caruisse quam peste.
reuse.text_original: Legimus in scolis pueri — et spirantia in plateis aera conspeximus — aliquem ossibus uix haerentem illicitis arsisse amoribus et ante uita caruisse quam peste.
reuse.text_english: We read in schools as boys, and we have seen bronze statues in the streets breathing; someone scarcely clinging to his bones has burned with forbidden loves and has lacked life before he lacked it through plague.
